title: Lily and the Enchanted Forest
moral: Friendship and courage can overcome any challenge.

scenes.summary: Lily goes into the forest to find her missing friend.
scenes.text: Lily entered the forest to find her missing friend Charlie the fox.
scenes.image_prompt: girl entering magical forest searching for fox, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: She faces obstacles like a river and cave.
scenes.text: She crossed a river and entered a dark cave while searching.
scenes.image_prompt: girl crossing river and entering cave, adventure cartoon

scenes.summary: She solves a riddle in the cave.
scenes.text: Inside the cave, she solved a riddle to move forward.
scenes.image_prompt: girl solving glowing riddle in cave, magical cartoon

scenes.text: She found Charlie trapped and freed him with courage.
scenes.image_prompt: girl hugging fox after rescue, emotional cartoon

scenes.text: They returned home safely and their friendship grew stronger.
scenes.image_prompt: girl and fox returning home happily, warm cartoon

story: Lily went into the forest to find her missing friend Charlie the fox. She crossed a river and entered a cave. Inside, she solved a riddle and found Charlie trapped. She freed him and they returned home together. Their friendship became stronger after the adventure.
